title: Kim N NDE 9659
content: I had a C-section and then started hemorrhaging vaginally. They could not stop the bleeding. I was starting to feel weak and dizzy. I also thought I was going to pass out, even though I was already lying down. When they started rolling me back into the operating room for emergency exploratory surgery, I was surrounded by a bright light from every direction, not just above me. I had the most peaceful feeling I have ever had. I can't explain it and I have never experienced that before or after. I was told that I had a decision. I could leave the earth or I could stay with my family. I saw my husband and newborn baby in the room. I decided I wanted to stay here with them. Then I woke up in recovery. I was in the hospital for a week and had to have five blood transfusions. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: October 19, 2005 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Surgery-related. Childbirth. Life threatening event, but not clinical death. I had a C-section and then I started hemorrhaging and they could not control it, so I was rushed back to the operating room for emergency surgery. How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Uncertain I felt like a either ‘saw’ my husband and newborn baby in my hospital room when I was not there, or that I just knew they were there. I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Less consciousness and alertness than normal. I was a little out of it from the medications, surgery and also hemorrhaging At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Right after the first surgery. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. They took my glasses from me so everything was blurry. It seemed even more blurry than normal with my glasses off. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. very quiet Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes It was a peaceful light that surrounded me; not just coming from above; coming from all directions, like engulfing me. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? peace Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life It was like I felt I had a decision to leave earth or to stay here. God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Other Christian Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I am certain about God and Heaven. What is your religion now? Christian- Other Christian Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes The same answer about going to Heaven. During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes I am Christian and believe in Jesus and God. I knew that what I was experiencing was going to Heaven. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I know that I was left here on earth, and it was not my time to die. I know there is a Heaven and that one day I will be there, but not yet. I am not scared to die. During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes I did feel like it was my purpose to stay on earth for my husband and newborn baby. During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes I felt like I was going to a very peaceful place. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life. I feel like when it is our time to go, then it is our time. We must enjoy the time we have here on earth, because you never know when it will end. I feel I was able to stay here because I still have things to do here and a purpose. I do not worry or stress about things as much as I used to. I am grateful for my experience. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Uncertain I don't really know After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes the peaceful feeling; it's hard to describe How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I have told friends and family. They seemed interested. My mother who is very spiritual knows it was God and Heaven. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes I had heard that people see a bright light and that there is a tunnel, and some people see Jesus. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I just knew and still know it was real. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

context.nde_cause_other_detail: C-section with uncontrolled vaginal hemorrhaging; rushed back for emergency exploratory surgery.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Reported seeing/knowing husband and newborn baby were in the room; no tunnel; no beings; no other world.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Bright light and peace occurred while being rolled back to the operating room; then told there was a decision to leave Earth or stay; chose to stay and then woke in recovery.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Light was described as coming from all directions (not only above) while still in the hospital setting; experiencer reported being told they had a decision to leave Earth or stay with family.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was surrounded by a bright light from every direction, not just above me.” “I was told that I had a decision. I could leave the earth or I could stay with my family.”
